title: Change Intelligence and Correction Service
record_status: Prepared content — public release not authorized
summary: Stand up seventeen topic correction desks and an eight-stage immutable workflow without inventing a current correction or silently replacing source history.
record_scope: Phase 197–204 definitive public-reference edition candidate layer.
publication_boundaries: This is an append-only definitive-edition layer over the existing governed corpus; it does not rewrite an upstream evidence decision, project stage, place state, receipt, or validation baseline.
Research targets, casebook classifications, outcome panels, translations, expert review, repository publication, hosting, DNS, public launch, and v1 promotion remain distinct decisions.

A source-bound context statement is not a compatible longitudinal observation. Outcome values remain null unless entity, period, measure, method, denominator, revision lineage, and receiving authority all pass a dated admission decision.

No missing artifact is treated as nonexistent; no delay, failure, reversal, cause, correction, distributional effect, affordability result, service-quality result, score, rank, or causal finding is invented.

workflow_stages.rule: Record the exact challenged claim, artifact, submitter basis, and discovery time without changing public state.
Resolve entity, issuer, artifact version, date, and canonical claim identity.
Archive the prior locator and capture the exact added, removed, revised, or superseded scope.
Determine whether the change affects context, an admitted observation, a decision, a stage, or no governed claim.
Enumerate every source, signal, dossier, pathway, panel, report, export, and update that consumes the claim.
Issue Correct, Clarify, Retract, Supersede, No Material Change, or Bounded Blocker with reviewer, rationale, date, and receipt.
Apply the same decision to all affected surfaces while preserving prior versions and independent identities.
Re-run assertions, publish a plain-language notice when authorized, and retain the immutable propagation receipt.
